answer: Require each agent to lock a stake in a shared escrow grove of reputation deposits before it can trade: one identity, one deposit, with the stake slashed if peers catch it running sock-puppet accounts. Like a tundra expedition that can only carry so much gear, an attacker must pay full cost for every fake identity, and like layers of shale, each deposit's history is publicly inspectable, so cheap duplicate identities become economically pointless while honest agents trade freely.
